userRequest: 先分阶段价值头，策略头不动，各阶段仍预测同一种胜平负价值。先训练一版
architecture: v1.37 tied D4 table 28503x32, original three pools and 97->32 trunk, original 46-row head retained; add opening 32->4 value/WLD readout. Total +132 parameters.

phase.transition: linear by exact integer empties, placements 12..24; quantize expert logits then blend and quantize before tanh/WLD CE
phase.targets: Same side-to-move outcome +1/0/-1 scalar and win/loss/draw classes for both readouts; terminal search unchanged

policy: Original conditional projection/gates/position bias and loss; jointly trained, no policy structure change and no frozen policy weights
data: Original fixed million WTHOR + Logistello hard-label positions; no Elo filtering or weighting, no aggregation; original validation/test unchanged
initialization: Same seed initializes identical original shared parameters; opening head copies original first four readout rows, giving identical initial predictions
loss: outcome MSE + 0.1 WLD CE + 0.1 legal policy CE
selection: Minimum original validation MSE over 15 epochs; test candidate only after selected weights frozen
checksBeforeTraining: New isolated Release build and CTest passed
Python phase interpolation, baseline initial identity, gradients, policy isolation, D4/color equivariance and 512-position native parity passed
limits: One seed, offline candidate; no strength conclusion or default promotion.
